gameDescriptionHtml:
Experience the character, monsters and world of the Rune Factory series through addictive nonogram logic-puzzles!

Game Features

  • Piczle Cross x Rune Factory – 300 nonogram puzzles with both classic and color variations! 20 collage puzzles, made up of many smaller puzzles, both in classic and color variations!
  • Fight and capture monsters! – Unlock entries in the in-game Bestiary and learn more about the beasts of Rigbarth!
  • Uncover villagers and bachelors! – Unlock entries in the in-game Compendium and learn about the characters in Rune Factory!
  • Customise your farm! – Customise your farm, pick your spouse and choose your weapons!
  • Play how you want! – Play how you want: laid-back and relaxed or challenging! A wealth of puzzle options to tweak the experience to your exact liking! Challenge yourself, …or don’t! There is no wrong way to play!
